newsitem.title: CHINA: China arrests Guangzhou's most wanted criminal.
newsitem.headline: China arrests Guangzhou's most wanted criminal.

text.p: Chinese police have arrested the southern city of Guangzhou's most-wanted criminal on charges of leading a gang that killed 17 people and pulled off more than 100 robberies, the Procuratorial Daily said on Tuesday.

Police arrested Zhang Zhicheng recently in the city of Shenzhen, 115 km (70 miles) southeast of Guangzhou, and found in his possession a gun and ammunition, the newspaper said. It gave no date for the arrest.
Area residents tipped off police on the location of Zhang's hideout after his picture was run in major newspapers in southern China.
Two key members of Zhang's gang were arrested in the central province of Hunan in May and 10 others have also been rounded up, the newspaper said without elaborating.
Zhang's gang engaged in a crime spree dating back to 1994, it said.

One of the gang's victims was a foreigner shot dead when he tried to fight off gang members robbing passengers on a bus in Guangzhou on July 25, 1995. The newspaper did not give the foreigner's nationality.
